notes: rsa.sign(message, key, 'SHA-256') with the key from rsa.PrivateKey.load_pkcs1. Pure Python integers. Its blinded_encrypt blinds with a fresh random factor but does not use the CRT: it does one plain 2048-bit exponentiation with d, ignoring the exp1, exp2 and coef the PEM carries, so it is several times slower than CRT entries.
